:::{#def-empirical-information}
#### Empirical information matrix

For mutually independent observations,
the **empirical information matrix** is
[@mclachlan2007em]:

$$
\oinf_e(\th; \vx) \eqdef
\sumin \score_i \tp{\score_i}
- \frac{1}{n} \score \tp{\score}
$$

where $\score_i$ is the score of the $i$th observation's log-likelihood,
and $\score = \sumin \score_i$.
:::
